column1: # Korean words for the engine's intelligibility test (tools/korean). kind<TAB>word<TAB>group
# Real, common words, so the recogniser isn't pulled away from a non-word; minimal sets where a
# single sound differs, so a confusion shows which sound. Loanwords are left out (Whisper writes
# stop: plain / tense / aspirated, the same frame
# fricative: plain / tense ㅅ ㅆ, and ㅎ
# liquid: ㄹ between vowels [ɾ], in a coda and doubled [l]
# coda: the seven final sounds, especially ㄴ ㅇ ㅁ
# vowel: ㅏ ㅓ ㅗ ㅜ ㅡ ㅣ ㅐ/ㅔ in one frame where it can be
# rule: words whose sound differs from their spelling (standard pronunciation)
